market_question: Will the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup?
reasoning: The Hurricanes are a strong team, but even the most dominant NHL teams rarely have more than a 10-12% pre-season implied probability to win the Cup. Projecting one specific team's chance for the 2025-26 season, the true likelihood is well below 10%, making the market's 37.5% a massive overestimate.
evidence_points: Preseason Stanley Cup futures for top favorites typically sit around +800 to +1000 (9-11% implied probability).
NHL parity means the average team has ~3% chance; even elite teams have at most a 12-15% chance in any given year.
The Hurricanes are not historically dominant (no recent dynasty) and face normal uncertainty over a full season.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of NHL futures betting markets
